transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. We've got four portable power units — P-1, P-2, P-3, and P-4 — all listed as serviceable and available. They need to cover the clinic, communications shelter, battery shop, and refrigerated storage for the coming week. Before I sign off on the allocation, I'd like each of you to walk through your area's needs and any concerns. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Colonel, before we go further, I need to flag something from yesterday's electrical inspection. P-2 is the only unit with the recently certified isolated-output transformer that the clinic's sensitive diagnostic equipment requires. The certification entry is still pending on the base inventory board, so it hasn't shown up there yet — but I personally confirmed it during the inspection. That means P-2 needs to go to the clinic.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Colonel, I need to flag something for the communications shelter. I confirmed this morning that the comm shelter's equipment requires regulated 28-volt output, which only P-4 provides. The updated compatibility note hasn't been added to the signal support annex yet, but I personally verified the requirement. So P-4 needs to go to the communications shelter.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Colonel, I need to flag something for the battery shop. I confirmed with the battery-shop supervisor that their charging rack requires P-1's approved connector and grounding lead. The shop's revised power worksheet hasn't been forwarded to the base planning cell yet, so that requirement isn't reflected in the current documentation — but I personally verified it with the supervisor. That means P-1 needs to go to the battery shop.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Colonel, I need to flag something for the refrigerated storage area. I've confirmed that the refrigerated storage area will receive a continuous-temperature shipment requiring P-3's 24-hour runtime capability. The receiving manifest hasn't been linked to the power-allocation request yet, so it isn't reflected in the current documentation — but I personally verified the requirement. That means P-3 needs to go to the refrigerated storage area.
transcript.speaker: A5
